limitations: AI source/editorial review is not independent human sign-off.
200 sign questions describe signs in text and do not assess image recognition.
500 prompts cover 250 paired concepts; full printed-handbook coverage was not established.
The proposed 40/20/20/16 rehearsal format still lacks authoritative confirmation.
No government prose or artwork licence is assumed; a commercial rights decision remains required.
